messages.author: 4e6060fd7b80ee80
messages.subject: Load a .Rdata file into Shiny
parts:
Hello guys,

My app needs to use the data table stored in a .Rdata file. I already copy the .Rdata file into the directory /srv/shiny-server/myapp, my question is: suppose the data table is a data frame called 'mydata' and the file is test.Rdata, so in the server.R file, how can I load in test.Rdata so the app can use 'mydata' to do some calculation?

Thank you,

Su

messages.author: a814dd0eade31e3e
messages.subject: Re: Load a .Rdata file into Shiny
parts:
Try:

df <- load('mydata.Rdata')

df will be the name of the object in the Rdata file.

Hi!
You can do it like this:
a<-iris
b<-mtcars
save(a,b,file="test.Rdata")

load("test.Rdata")
head(a)
head(b)
